svg.title: PCB Defect Detection, Live demo
svg.desc: Fine-tuned YOLOv8 for circuit-board inspection. How it works: PCB images → YOLOv8 → defects found → annotated ZIP. Upload one PCB image or a batch; a fine-tuned YOLOv8 marks the defects, charts their distribution and exports the annotated images. Stack: Python, YOLOv8, PyTorch, Streamlit. Result: mAP@0.5 above 85%; Programme: Intel® AI for Manufacturing.
